notes: Read all 271 source lines line by line before editing. Every line is accounted for below; the card is a pure prop-derivation wrapper over the shared UsageCard primitive, so the conversion is a faithful 1:1 port with only DOM-only dependencies remapped to their existing native parity equivalents.

L1-19 JSDoc header (purpose: combine /system/api-usage snapshot with /api-logs/stats; the four operator questions; delegation of the JSX skeleton to the shared <UsageCard>): ported as the native header comment, preserving all four bullet questions and the 'sole job is to derive props from the two API hooks' rationale, plus an added native-remap paragraph documenting the lucide/useFormatting/numberFormat substitutions.
L21 `import { useMemo } from 'react'`: kept verbatim (RN supports useMemo); the derived useMemo keeps the identical [apiUsage, logStats, now] dependency array.

L22 `import { Activity, TrendingUp, Zap, Clock } from 'lucide-react'`: DOM SVG icon lib forbidden in native. Each small inline h-3.5 w-3.5 icon -> a monochrome AppText glyph via the local InlineGlyph component + ICON_GLYPH map (Activity->'◉' U+25C9 fisheye, matching the sibling LiveStatusPill Activity mapping; Clock->'◷' U+25F7 clock-quadrant; TrendingUp->'↗' U+2197 up-right trend arrow; Zap->'↯' U+21AF lightning-like zigzag). Tinted to the muted label colour so they read inside UsageCard's 14x14 inlineIcon slot — the LiveStatusPill/AutomationActivityFeed inline-glyph precedent (heavier bordered SemanticIcon chips are 30-52px and would overflow).

L23 `import { useApiLogStats } from '@/api/hooks/useAdmin'`: -> native '../../../../api/hooks/useAdmin'. The native useApiLogStats queries the same '/api-logs/stats' path and returns APICallLogStats whose interface declares the exact camelCase keys this card reads (last24h/avgDurationMs/errorRate/errorCount) plus snake_case by_method/by_service, so no key remapping is needed.

L24 `import { useFormatting } from '@/hooks/useFormatting'`: no native useFormatting hook. formatCurrency is rebuilt from the native useFormatPrefs() (components/data-display/format/_formatPrimitives) — formatCurrency(amount, decimals?) = `${currencySymbol}${fmt(amount, decimals)}`, byte-equivalent to web `${currencySymbol}${fmtNumber(amount, decimals ?? userPrecision)}` since fmt defaults its decimals to the settings-derived precision.

L25-32 `import { UsageCard, type UsageCardBand, UsageCardDetail, UsageCardTopList, UsageCardTopListItem, UsageCardIntent } from '@/components/data-display'`: -> the native data-display barrel '../../../../components/data-display', which re-exports the ported native UsageCard and the identical type contract (verified UsageCard.tsx exports UsageCardBand/Detail/TopList/TopListItem/Intent/Budget/Banner/FooterLink).

L33 `import type { APIUsage } from '@/api/types'`: -> native '../../../../api/types' APIUsage (total_requests/skipped_polls/estimated_cost/cost_per_request/monthly_credit/estimated_remaining) — byte-identical shape.

L34 `import { fmtInt, fmtPercent } from '@/lib/numberFormat'`: no native numberFormat module. Ported onto useFormatPrefs().fmt exactly per the DataPipelineSection precedent: fmtPercent(v, d) = `${fmt(v, d)}%` and fmtInt is folded into fmtCount = Number.isFinite(n) ? fmt(n, 0) : '—'. Settings-driven + locale-aware like the web global-precision formatters.

L36-40 `interface TeslaApiUsageCardProps { apiUsage: APIUsage | undefined; now: number }`: ported verbatim, including the JSDoc on `now` ('"now" passed in so the page-level tick re-renders the countdown.').
L42-45 `function startOfMonth(now)`: ported verbatim at module level (new Date(now) -> new Date(year, month, 1)).
L47-50 `function endOfMonth(now)`: ported verbatim at module level (new Date(year, month+1, 1)).

L52-55 `function fmtCount(n)`: ported as a component-scoped closure (it depends on the hook-derived fmt): `if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return '—'; return fmtInt(n)` -> `Number.isFinite(n) ? fmt(n, 0) : '—'`, same '—' guard and integer (0-decimal) formatting.

L57-61 the camelCaseKeys explanatory comment (by_service yields {tesla_fleet, teslaFleet} duplicate clones): ported and re-pointed at the native api/client.ts camelCaseKeys, which was verified to apply the same recursive dual snake/camel transform — so the dedupe is genuinely required on native too.

L62-81 `function dedupeMap(m)`: ported verbatim at module level — same Object.entries, same snakeKeys filter on k.includes('_'), same alias Set built via sk.replace(/_([a-z0-9])/g, (_, c) => c.toUpperCase()), same `if (aliases.has(k) && !k.includes('_')) continue`, same lowercase/strip-underscore `norm` seen-Set dedupe, returning Array<[string, number]>.

L83-85 `export function TeslaApiUsageCard({ apiUsage, now })` + `const { data: logStats } = useApiLogStats()` + `const { formatCurrency } = useFormatting()`: ported; useFormatting destructure becomes `const { currencySymbol, fmt } = useFormatPrefs()` with a local formatCurrency built from them (plus fmtPercent/fmtCount closures).

L87-121 `const derived = useMemo(...)`: ported verbatim — monthStart/monthEnd via startOfMonth/endOfMonth, totalDaysInMonth/daysElapsed/daysRemaining math (Math.ceil/Math.max identical), pctOfBudget guarded on monthly_credit > 0, dailyAvgCost, dailyAvgRequests (computed + returned for parity even though unused downstream, matching the web), the two forecast methods (forecastFromMtd linear MTD extrapolation + last24hBurn = (logStats?.last24h ?? 0) * cost_per_request + forecastFromRecent), and the identical returned object + [apiUsage, logStats, now] deps. The L103-105 'Forecast end-of-month using two methods' comment is preserved.

L123-127 the `if (!apiUsage || !derived)` early return -> `<UsageCard emptyMessage="Tesla API usage data is not available yet." />` ported verbatim (native UsageCard renders the emptyMessage when no sections are supplied).
L129-134 `overBudget` + `budgetIntent: UsageCardIntent` (danger if over, warn if pct>80, else normal): ported verbatim.
L136-139 `topServices` = dedupeMap(by_service).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,3) with the 'Top 3 services by call count' comment: ported verbatim.
L141 `methodEntries` = dedupeMap(by_method).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]): ported verbatim.

L143-145 `usefulRequests` = total_requests - skipped_polls; the 'Backend returns error_rate as a PERCENTAGE already' comment; `errorPct` = logStats?.errorRate != null ? logStats.errorRate : null: ported verbatim (reads the native APICallLogStats.errorRate camelCase alias).

L147-177 `bands: UsageCardBand[]` (three entries): ported. Icons Activity/Clock/TrendingUp -> InlineGlyph chips. The web `<>{count} requests` composite values -> the local CountWithUnit component (nested RN : primary semibold count + muted smaller 'requests' suffix). Band 1 'This month' value fmtCount(total_requests)/requests, sub `${formatCurrency(dailyAvgCost)}/day avg`; band 2 'Last 24h' value (last24h != null ? fmtCount(last24h) : '—')/requests preserving the '— requests' null render, sub `${formatCurrency(last24hBurn)}/day burn`; band 3 'Forecast EOM' value formatCurrency(forecastFromMtd) string, sub `recent rate: ${formatCurrency(forecastFromRecent)}`, intent danger when forecastFromMtd > monthly_credit else normal.
L179-184 `errorIntent: UsageCardIntent` (danger if errorPct>=5, warn if >=1, else normal): ported verbatim.

L186-211 `details: UsageCardDetail[]` (four entries): ported. 'Useful' = fmtCount(usefulRequests); 'Skipped (asleep)' = fmtCount(skipped_polls); 'Avg latency' = avgDurationMs != null ? `${Math.round(avgDurationMs)} ms` : '—'; 'Error rate' = errorPct != null ? composite (`fmtPercent(errorPct,1)` + optional muted `(${fmtCount(errorCount)})` suffix when errorCount != null) : '—', intent: errorIntent. The web `<span class='ml-1 text-xs text-muted'>` -> a nested muted AppText with a leading space, and because the native UsageCard only colours plain string/number detail values, the composite percentage is explicitly tinted via DETAIL_VALUE_COLOR[errorIntent] (a local mirror of UsageCard's internal VALUE_TEXT map: normal->textPrimary, warn->#fcd34d, danger->#f87171) so the intent colour is preserved.

L213-237 `topLists: UsageCardTopList[]` built imperatively: ported verbatim. Pushes a 'services' list (icon Zap->InlineGlyph, title 'Top services', items topServices.map<UsageCardTopListItem>(([name,count]) => ({key:name,label:name,value:fmtCount(count)}))) only when topServices.length>0, and a 'methods' list (icon Activity->InlineGlyph, title 'By method', same item mapping over methodEntries) only when methodEntries.length>0 — same keys, same guards, same generic .map<UsageCardTopListItem>.

L239-269 the final `<UsageCard .../>` render: ported with all props preserved — budget {headline `${formatCurrency(estimated_cost)} of ${formatCurrency(monthly_credit)}`, rightLabel `${fmtPercent(pctOfBudget,0)} of monthly credit`, caption `Day ${daysElapsed} of ${totalDaysInMonth} ·${daysRemaining===0 ? ' resets tomorrow' : ` resets in ${daysRemaining} day${daysRemaining===1?'':'s'}`}`, pct pctOfBudget, ariaLabel 'Tesla API budget used', intent budgetIntent}; bands; details; topLists; banner (overBudget ? {title 'Over monthly credit', description `Spend has exceeded the ${formatCurrency(monthly_credit)} monthly credit by ${formatCurrency(estimated_cost - monthly_credit)}. Review polling cadence or vehicle subscriptions.`, intent 'danger'} : undefined); footer [{key 'logs', to '/api-logs', label 'Open API Logs', primary true}, {key 'tesla', to '/tesla-account', label 'Tesla account'}] (the router `to` targets are preserved on the native UsageCardFooterLink; native footer Pressables route via the optional onFooterLinkPress, unused here exactly as the web card passes no nav handler). The <UsageCard> JSX props are alphabetised (bands/banner/budget/details/footer/topLists) to satisfy react/jsx-sort-props; prop values are byte-identical to the web.
L270-271 closing braces: ported; the component is additionally default-exported for native import ergonomics, consistent with the sibling LiveStatusPill port.

i18n intent: the source uses NO react-i18next — every label ('This month', 'Last 24h', 'requests', 'Forecast EOM', 'Useful', 'Skipped (asleep)', 'Avg latency', 'Error rate', 'Top services', 'By method', 'Over monthly credit', 'Open API Logs', 'Tesla account', the empty message) is a hard-coded English string. Preserved verbatim with no i18n shim, matching the source's i18n intent exactly.

Unit handling: no SI/unit-suffixed fields are touched — the card reads monetary (estimated_cost/monthly_credit/cost_per_request), counts (total_requests/skipped_polls/last24h/errorCount), latency ms (avgDurationMs) and a percentage (errorRate). Currency formatting flows through useFormatPrefs() so the user's currency symbol + locale + decimal precision are applied at the display boundary, identical to web useFormatting.

Gates run from apps/native: `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint -- --quiet`, `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles`. No DOM-only modules, HTML elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI components are imported — only React useMemo, the react-native StyleSheet primitive, the existing native AppText component + theme colours, and the already-ported native UsageCard / useApiLogStats / useFormatPrefs / APIUsage parity dependencies.
